data.title: 伊内丝 · 演出前的停顿
data.description: 她在镜前整理领口，透过镜面看向你。听完你的评价，伊内丝稍稍偏过头，嘴角终于有了一点笑意。
data.action: 扶镜回眸，指尖整理领口
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Inside a chic backstage dressing room with glowing Hollywood marquee bulbs, Ines sits at a vanity table, meticulously checking her reflection while surrounded by piles of performance props, colorful makeup palettes, and silk garments. The atmosphere is bustling and filled with the scent of hairspray and excitement, reflected beautifully in the large vanity mirror.
